meta.description: Context-aware unsafe behavior rulebook for hazard reasoning.

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker missing hardhat or reflective vest in general construction work
rules.regulation: worker should wear hardhat and reflective vest during general construction work

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker uses tools without hardhat, reflective vest, or gloves
rules.regulation: worker should wear hardhat, reflective vest, and gloves when using tools

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker in rebar work area without hardhat, reflective vest, or gloves
rules.regulation: worker should wear hardhat, reflective vest, and gloves in rebar work area

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker in bricklaying area without hardhat, reflective vest, or gloves
rules.regulation: worker should wear hardhat, reflective vest, and gloves when bricklaying

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker operates excavator without hardhat or reflective vest
rules.regulation: worker should wear hardhat and reflective vest when operating excavator

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker approaches excavator without PPE or safe distance
rules.regulation: worker near excavator should wear hardhat and reflective vest and keep safety distance

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker on scaffold without hardhat or reflective vest
rules.regulation: worker on scaffold should wear hardhat and reflective vest

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker near unprotected edge without hardhat or reflective vest
rules.regulation: worker near unprotected edge should wear hardhat and reflective vest and avoid dangerous approach

rules.unsafe_behavior: worker welds without hardhat, gloves, or facial mask
rules.regulation: worker should wear hardhat, gloves, and facial mask during welding
